page.overview:
What is Quilin Mountain?

Quilin Mountain is a colossal pointed mountain which blotted out the sun. The area around the mountain is a pile of torn-up cliffs with jagged rocks at the bottom. It is located three thousand miles south of the Scarlet-Purple Kingdom.
